memo.headline: Prioritize clearer, more predictable free-tier playback limits
memo.recommendation: Spend next quarter clarifying which playback choices are available on the free tier and making restrictions feel consistent and transparent. Free-tier playback restrictions lead the issue ranking by complaint count [C1] and priority score [C2]. Reviews describe being unable to choose a specific song and perceiving that the update made everything premium (d146397f-4a94-4980-be00-ae9212eca3a7; 21915fcd-9a35-48ba-b277-6296c4154603). Treat the cancellation-language example as expressed intent, not evidence of observed churn (88439ec2-7c49-4c57-bedb-c5e098692aff).

alternatives.why_lower: Usability has more complaints across its area aggregate, but its leading ranked issue, ads, has a lower priority score than free-tier restrictions [C3]. Address ad loudness and frequency as a follow-on; reviews specifically mention loud ads and ads interrupting songs (ab67a772-c3b7-42ba-9b80-8d21d3857018; cf6166ae-d71a-4839-9add-088645ad3b78).

Playback has fewer complaints overall than billing_support in the area aggregates. Its crash/loading issue is serious, with severity-4 reports of crashes and a stuck loading screen, but has a lower priority score [C4] (55cc3abf-c295-4591-8c3a-78085cfdefaa; 66a29b3c-c14d-440e-b722-b23e0c99ae82).
Login failure is severe in the sampled reviews, but its ranked priority score is lower [C5] and the area aggregate covers fewer complaints than billing_support.

limitations: This is a self-selected sample of historical Google Play reviews, not a representative measure of all Spotify users.
The classification scope is a uniform seeded sample; no rows were unclassified within budget, but findings remain bounded by that sample and the stated review window.
Model labels and issue assignments may be wrong; validate against support and product data before acting.
Cancellation language expresses reviewer intent, not observed churn.
No revenue data was supplied; these results do not estimate revenue at risk or causal impact.
